# SIVO Meme Library — License Record (Phase 2)

**Every meme in `public/memes/` is ORIGINAL artwork generated by SIVO code**
(`scripts/make_memes.py`: PIL shapes + ffmpeg). No Tenor/Giphy GIFs, no
third-party images, no copied meme formats, no text. There are NO license
restrictions on these files — they are authored by the SIVO project and
ship with the product.

To regenerate: `python3 scripts/make_memes.py` (overwrites `public/memes/`).

| File | What it shows | Used where |
|---|---|---|
| `pain-01.mp4` | Red arrow falling + descending zigzag — problem / losses | Explainer Pain scene (only meme slot in the product) |
| `pain-02.mp4` | Leaky bucket, oscillating water, drips falling — losing money | Library (not auto-assigned in Phase 2) |
| `pain-03.mp4` | Clock with a fast-spinning red hand — time pressure | Library (not auto-assigned in Phase 2) |
| `solution-01.mp4` | Lightbulb with pulsing rays — an idea | Library (not auto-assigned in Phase 2) |
| `solution-02.mp4` | Green arrow rising + ascending zigzag — growth | Library (not auto-assigned in Phase 2) |
| `workflow-01.mp4` | Two gears turning opposite directions — process | Library (not auto-assigned in Phase 2) |
| `workflow-02.mp4` | Checklist, checkmarks cycling in sequence — steps | Library (not auto-assigned in Phase 2) |
| `benefits-01.mp4` | Coins dropping into a piggy bank — savings | Library (not auto-assigned in Phase 2) |
| `outro-01.mp4` | Rocket rising, stars streaming, flame flickering — ship / success | Library (not auto-assigned in Phase 2) |
| `outro-02.mp4` | Trophy with twinkling stars — a win | Library (not auto-assigned in Phase 2) |

**Why only `pain-01` is auto-assigned:** Phase 2 assigns a meme only to the
Explainer Pain scene (plan §3.5: deterministic selection, customer never
chooses). The other 9 memes are in the library for future template slots;
adding a meme to a new slot is a one-line change in `build_props.py`
(`scene["meme"] = "memes/<name>.mp4"`), no license review needed because
every file here is SIVO-original.

**Rules for future memes (do not break these):**
1. NEVER add a Tenor/Giphy/Internet GIF to this folder — the GIFs from
   the Docker test were never cleared for redistribution in a product.
2. New memes must be drawn by code (like `make_memes.py`) or come with a
   written commercial-use permission recorded in this file.
3. No text inside meme videos (captions overlay on top in the composition).
4. Every motion must loop seamlessly (sin or modulo wrap over the 2s loop).
